cards.ex: I've got a huge exam next week, so I really need to hit the books this weekend.
cards.exUz: Kelasi hafta katta imtihonim bor, shuning uchun dam olish kunlari qattiq o'qishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Imtihonga tayyorlanish uchun qattiq o'qish, o'rganish.

cards.ex: The teacher asked us to learn the poem by heart.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi bizdan she'rni yod olishimizni so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni to'liq yodlash, esda saqlash.

cards.ex: I had to pull an all-nighter to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Loyihani vaqtida tugatish uchun tun bo'yi ishlashim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir ishni bajarish uchun tun bo'yi uxlamay ishlash.

cards.ex: I need to brush up on my Spanish before my trip to Spain.
cards.exUz: Ispaniyaga sayohatimdan oldin ispan tilini eslatib o'tishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Unutilgan bilimlarni qayta esga tushirish.

cards.ex: If you miss too many classes, you'll start to fall behind.
cards.exUz: Agar juda ko'p dars qoldirsangiz, ortda qolasiz.
cards.uzDef: Darslarda yoki topshiriqlarda ortda qolish.

cards.ex: I need to catch up on my reading this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men dam olish kunlarida o'qishga yetib olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ortda qolgan narsalarga yetib olish.

cards.ex: She passed the exam with flying colors.
cards.exUz: U imtihondan a'lo baho bilan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Imtihondan juda yaxshi natija bilan o'tish.

cards.ex: He got in trouble for cutting class too often.
cards.exUz: U juda tez-tez dars qoldirgani uchun muammoga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Darsga bormaslik, qoldirib ketish.

cards.ex: I think I aced that math test!
cards.exUz: Menimcha, matematika imtihonidan a'lo o'tdim!
cards.uzDef: Imtihondan juda yuqori ball olish.

cards.ex: I had to burn the midnight oil to get the report done.
cards.exUz: Hisobotni tugatish uchun kechgacha ishlashim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha yoki tun bo'yi qattiq ishlash, o'qish.

cards.ex: Learning to code was a steep learning curve, but I'm getting there.
cards.exUz: Dasturlashni o'rganish juda qiyin bo'ldi, lekin men o'rganib ketyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni o'rganishning juda qiyin va tez bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I picked up some basic Italian while traveling in Italy.
cards.exUz: Italiyada sayohat qilganimda italyan tilining asoslarini o'rganib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni oson va tez o'rganish.

cards.ex: It takes a while to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishlashni o'rganish biroz vaqt talab etadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki faoliyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: She's a real bookworm; she always has a book with her.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy kitobxon; u har doim o'zi bilan kitob olib yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Kitob o'qishni juda yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: The professor droned on for hours about the history of economics.
cards.exUz: Professor iqtisodiyot tarixi haqida soatlab zerikarli gapirdi.
cards.uzDef: Zerikarli mavzuda uzoq vaqt gapirish.

cards.ex: I'm planning to major in computer science.
cards.exUz: Men kompyuter fanlari bo'yicha yo'nalish tanlashni rejalashtiryapman.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda asosiy yo'nalishni tanlash.

cards.ex: She's a quick study; she learned the new software in no time.
cards.exUz: U tez o'rganuvchi; u yangi dasturni tezda o'rganib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni tez va oson o'rganadigan odam.

cards.ex: If you want to get a good grade, you need to hit the books hard.
cards.exUz: Agar yaxshi baho olmoqchi bo'lsangiz, zo'r berib o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Imtihonga yoki vazifaga tayyorlanish uchun qattiq o'qish.

cards.ex: He never cracks a book, but he somehow always passes his exams.
cards.exUz: U hech qachon kitob ochmaydi, lekin qandaydir tarzda doim imtihonlardan o'tadi.
cards.uzDef: O'qish uchun kitobni ochmoq (ko'pincha kamdan kam hollarda).

cards.ex: The teacher always does everything by the book.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi har doim hamma narsani qoidaga binoan qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga va yo'riqnomalarga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: He learned everything he knows in the school of hard knocks.
cards.exUz: U bilgan hamma narsani hayot maktabida o'rgangan.
cards.term: in the school of hard knocks
cards.uzDef: Tajriba orqali o'rganish, rasmiy ta'lim emas.

cards.ex: He dropped out of college after his first year.
cards.exUz: U birinchi yildan keyin kollejni tashladi.
cards.uzDef: O'qishni tugatmasdan tark etish.

cards.ex: Alright, everyone, let's get our thinking caps on and solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, hammamiz, o'ylashga kirishamiz va bu muammoni hal qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun qattiq o'ylashni boshlash.

cards.ex: I need some time to mull over this decision.
cards.exUz: Bu qaror haqida o'ylash uchun menga biroz vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida uzoq vaqt chuqur o'ylash.

cards.ex: I had to cram for the test last night.
cards.exUz: Men kecha imtihonga tayyorlanishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Imtihon oldidan juda qisqa vaqt ichida qattiq o'qish.

cards.ex: Their teaching styles are like chalk and cheese.
cards.exUz: Ularning o'qitish uslublari osmon bilan yerdek.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay farqli narsalar, solishtirib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: She knows that book inside out; she's read it a hundred times.
cards.exUz: U bu kitobni mukammal biladi; uni yuz marta o'qigan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni mukammal darajada bilish.

cards.ex: He's still pretty green, but he's learning fast.
cards.exUz: U hali juda tajribasiz, lekin tez o'rganmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tajribasiz, yangi ish boshlagan.

cards.ex: Don't try to pass the buck; it's your responsibility.
cards.exUz: Mas'uliyatni o'tkazishga urinmang; bu sizning mas'uliyatingiz.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamga mas'uliyat yoki aybni o'tkazish.

cards.ex: Your essay is good, but there's always room for improvement.
cards.exUz: Sizning inshoyingiz yaxshi, lekin har doim yaxshilanishga imkon bor.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan joylar, kamchiliklar.
